mechanism_narrative: A persistent increase in FEDFUNDS above 4% for two consecutive months predicts higher S&P 500 20-day forward returns due to expectations of accommodative monetary policy and reduced risk aversion.
regime_hint: high inflation or recession risk environment
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically higher than the 30-day moving average of the prior month (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Rising monthly PAYEMS accompanied by UNRATE below 6% suggests a tight labor market without extreme wage inflation, which is associated with positive S&P 500 60-day forward returns.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases while UNRATE < 6% over the prior 3 months
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns under this signal are negative in 70% of instances (rolling IC < -0.1).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in HOUST (industrial production) above its 12-month moving average indicates accelerating economic activity, which is expected to drive positive S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: No significant correlation between HOUST acceleration and 20-day forward returns (Pearson's rho < 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in INDPRO below 100 (2017 index) for two consecutive months signals supply-side weakness, which is associated with negative S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 20-day returns remain positive despite INDPRO falling below 100 for the required horizon (IC > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Consecutive monthly declines in both CPIAUCSL and FEDFUNDS predict negative S&P 500 5-day forward returns as investors anticipate deflationary pressure and tighter policy.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL < previous month AND FEDFUNDS < previous month for two consecutive months
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not statistically different from zero under this signal (p > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: A sudden spike in PAYEMS above 150,000 while UNRATE remains below 4%, signals strong labor demand without wage pressures, which should produce positive 20-day forward returns.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS > 150000 AND UNRATE < 4% in the current month
regime_hint: labor market expansion without wage inflation
failure_condition: 20-day returns are negative when this trigger is met (IC < -0.2).

mechanism_narrative: A prolonged decline in GDPC1 (real GDP) over 6 months predicts negative S&P 500 60-day forward returns as market anticipates economic softening.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly different from the 60-day moving average (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When RSAFS (retail sales) exceeds 600,000 for three consecutive months in a deflationary regime (CPIAUCSL < 270), S&P 500 20-day forward returns are expected to be positive due to optimism about consumer demand.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS > 600000 AND CPIAUCSL < 270 for three consecutive months AND regime: deflationary
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns under this signal are negative in 80% of cases (IC < -0.15).
